qualification.details: Senior Energy Consultant | Bachelor's Degree in Engineering (Electrical, Mechanical, Electrical & Electronics, Energy Engineering, Renewable Energy Engineering or equivalent) or Architecture from a recognized University. Minimum 10 years of post-qualification experience in Energy Efficiency, Energy Conservation, Renewable Energy, Electrical Utilities, Power Sector, Government Energy Projects or related fields. Minimum four (04) years of relevant professional experience in implementation of Bureau of Energy Efficiency (BEE) programmes through a State Designated Agency (SDA). Experience in implementation of programmes under the Energy Conservation Act, 2001. | Assistant Energy Consultant | Bachelor's Degree in Engineering (Electrical/Mechanical/Electrical & Electronics/Energy Engineering/Renewable Energy Engineering or equivalent) or Architecture from a recognized University. More than three (03) years of post-qualification relevant professional experience in Energy Efficiency, Energy Conservation, Renewable Energy, Electrical Utilities, Power Sector or related fields. Minimum two (02) year of experience in implementation of Bureau of Energy Efficiency (BEE) programmes through a State Designated Agency (SDA). Experience in implementation of programmes under the Energy Conservation Act, 2001.

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Senior Energy Consultant Bachelor's Degree in Engineering (Electrical, Mechanical, Electrical & Electronics, Energy Engineering, Renewable Energy Engineering or equivalent) or Architecture from a recognized University. Minimum 10 years of post-qualification experience in Energy Efficiency, Energy Conservation, Renewable Energy, Electrical Utilities, Power Sector, Government Energy Projects or related fields. Minimum four (04) years of relevant professional experience in implementation of Bureau of Energy Efficiency (BEE) programmes through a State Designated Agency (SDA). Experience in implementation of programmes under the Energy Conservation Act, 2001. Assistant Energy Consultant Bachelor's Degree in Engineering (Electrical/Mechanical/Electrical & Electronics/Energy Engineering/Renewable Energy Engineering or equivalent) or Architecture from a recognized University. More than three (03) years of post-qualification relevant professional experience in Energy Efficiency, Energy Conservation, Renewable Energy, Electrical Utilities, Power Sector or related fields. Minimum two (02) year of experience in implementation of Bureau of Energy Efficiency (BEE) programmes through a State Designated Agency (SDA). Experience in implementation of programmes under the Energy Conservation Act, 2001.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Scrutiny of applications and verification of eligibility criteria. Preparation of the list of eligible and ineligible candidates. Shortlisting of eligible candidates, wherever considered necessary, based on the prescribed eligibility criteria and relevant experience. Personal Interview of the shortlisted candidates through virtual mode by the duly constituted Selection Committee. Recommendation of suitable candidate(s) by the Selection Committee based on the candidate's educational qualifications, relevant professional experience, technical competence, knowledge of Bureau of Energy Efficiency (BEE) programmes and overall suitability for the post. Approval of the recommendations by the Competent Authority.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for Lakshadweep Administration Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: https://lakshadweep.gov.in/ Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 20-09-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Lakshadweep Administration recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of applications is 20th September 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well in advance to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What are the educational qualifications required for the posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Bachelor's Degree in Engineering or Architecture from a recognized university. Specific engineering disciplines are mentioned for each post in the detailed notification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Senior Energy Consultant and Assistant Energy Consultant posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for both positions is 45 years. No specific age relaxation details are provided in the summary.

faq.question: Q4. How can I apply for these positions?
faq.answer: Applications can be submitted offline by post or via email to the address and email ID mentioned in the official notification.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for these contractual roles?
faq.answer: The Senior Energy Consultant will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 65,000/-, while the Assistant Energy Consultant will receive Rs. 55,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification does not mention any application fee for these positions. Candidates should verify this in the detailed advertisement.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process involves scrutiny of applications, verification of eligibility, shortlisting based on qualifications and experience, and a personal interview.

faq.question: Q8. What type of job is this recruitment for?
faq.answer: These are contractual positions within the Lakshadweep Administration. The job type is contract-based.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of the Lakshadweep Administration, which is https://powerlak.gov.in/.

faq.question: Q10. What documents are required to be submitted with the application?
faq.answer: Candidates need to submit self-attested copies of supporting documents, including educational certificates, experience certificates, and identity proof, as specified in the application form.
